_comment: Golden set for the generation eval harness (python -m app.eval.harness). Offline runs use a deterministic stand-in; --live measures real Gemini quality on these prompts. Add cases as the product grows.

cases.prompt: Show how Nimbus AI helps Vanguard Freight cut idle fleet hours and improve on-time delivery. Practical, evidence-led tone.

facts.text: Nimbus AI re-plans routes in real time as orders and traffic shift.
At comparable fleets, Nimbus cut idle time by 28% and lifted on-time delivery by 12 points.
Nimbus deploys in weeks on a customer's existing telematics stack.

receiver.name: Vanguard Freight
pain_points: manual dispatch leaves trucks idle between loads
key_stats: 1.9 idle hours per truck per day

facts.text: Vanguard Freight operates 480 trucks across the Benelux.
Manual dispatch leaves each vehicle idle nearly two hours a day.

cases.prompt: Make the case that Helios Energy can cut Brightway Retail's store energy costs without disrupting operations.

facts.text: Helios funds installs through a power-purchase agreement, so customers pay no upfront capex.
Retail sites on Helios saw up to 35% lower energy spend within the first year.
Helios schedules installation around trading hours to avoid disrupting stores.

receiver.name: Brightway Retail
pain_points: energy is the second-largest operating cost
key_stats: energy is ~18% of store operating cost

facts.text: Brightway Retail runs 240 grocery stores with 24/7 refrigeration.
Energy is roughly 18% of Brightway's store operating cost.
